Descriptive statement of purpose; no concrete verifiable behavior beyond what T3.1-01 already covers.
Firmware guidance/software programming advice; not a hardware behavior to verify.

questions.question: Section 3.2.2 says each hart can have multiple mtimecmp/comparators, but this version is fixed to one timer per hart. Which applies for verification? Does the per-hart interrupt enable/state set conflict with the multi-timer text?
When exactly does the tick occur relative to the counter (counter == prescaler, then reset to 0?), and what happens if CFG0.prescaler is 0 or CFG0.prescaler/step are changed while running?
Is the interrupt level-sensitive (stays asserted while mtime >= mtimecmp) or latched until cleared, and is the comparison done on every cycle or only on ticks?
